programme.desc: The new vet is hitting the road! Dr. Michele picked a good week, feisty bulls need wrangling, a reluctant horse needs dental work, and a series of pregnancy checks kick off the week. Add to the mix an emergency goat kidding and a little kitten with a crippling leg problem. .

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T13 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Veterinarii fac eforturi sa salveze ni?te alpacale galagioase, pe Luna, dragala?ul iepura? terapeutic ?i pe Twinkie, cel mai simpatic iedu? din lume!.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T14 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: It's a bull-wrangling, calf-chasing, pig-squealing good time this week on The Incredible Dr. Pol! The docs have their hands full doing what they do best: saving animals in distress-though that doesn't mean it's always easy!.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Australia's rivers, wetlands, lakes and floodplains provide the perfect nursery for an extraordinary collection of young wildlife. Meet a diverse group of animal youngsters as they take their first steps, swim and dive into the world.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: The quiet charm of Germany’s Central Uplands lies in ancient forests and wild beauty. Through the autumn forest, the booming call of a stag echoes through the mist. It’s rutting season! In Saxon Switzerland, peregrine falcons and black storks inhabit picturesque cliffs. The elusive lynx roams the forests, while in the Harz, a new, wilder forest is growing in the shifting climate.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: At the western end of the Mediterranean lies Portugal, full of diverse ecosystems that showcase a stunning array of species both big and small, many of which are endemic to the region. Its interconnected web allows each creature a way to survive the rugged landscape. A fire salamander that can live up to 50 years enjoys its first meal after spending a dormant summer underground.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Life on the coast of Portugal is full of beauty and brutality for the unique animals that live there, from the smallest phytoplankton to the giant sperm whales. Fiddler crabs fight for breeding rights in the coastal lagoons. Cuttlefish, the ultimate masters of disguise, creep in on unsuspecting prey. Storks perch precariously on the Atlantic cliffs, protecting their chicks from predators.

programme.title: Gredos - King Of The Mountains - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Through the cycle of the seasons, Spain’s Sierra de Gredos National Park, one of Europe’s most remarkable natural landscapes, is revealed. From ancient glacial cirques and deep mountain ravines to the summit of Almanzor, the highest peak in central Spain, discover a unique and fragile ecosystem. Here, the Spanish ibex, an iconic species that defines the spirit of these mountains, reigns.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: At the western end of the Mediterranean lies Portugal, full of diverse ecosystems that showcase a stunning array of species both big and small, many of which are endemic to the region. Its interconnected web allows each creature a way to survive the rugged landscape. A fire salamander that can live up to 50 years enjoys its first meal after spending a dormant summer underground.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Summer grants abundance, but in the race to make the most of a brief window of warmth, it also brings competition, aggression and danger. High up on the mountain meadows, Alpine marmots fight for the best hideouts in which to raise young, but can they escape hungry bears? The Carpathian bear cubs are growing fast but are at risk of being attacked by competitive adult males. Can their mothers’ clever strategies protect them?

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders T1 - Ep. 2

Fiddler crabs fight for breeding rights in the coastal lagoons. Cuttlefish, the ultimate masters of disguise, creep in on unsuspecting prey. Storks perch precariously on the Atlantic cliffs, protecting their chicks from predators.

programme.title: Supersized Sharks - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Has a small island in the middle of the South Pacific become a drive-thru burger joint for the world’s largest Tiger Sharks? Luring the giants to their boat, shark biologists Lauren Meyers, Charlie Huveneers and Adam Barnette investigate and are surprised to discover that beef is not the only unusual item on the menu.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: The Pol’s new livestock aren’t potty trained; their sheep hut isn’t draining properly and has now been transformed into a Pee Palace. It’s late fall and the winter deep freeze is just around the corner, so the family needs to get it fixed fast. The Pol’s also get a new sheep for their farm.

programme.title: Crocodiles Of The Okavango - Ep. 1
programme.desc: In Botswana’s Okavango Delta, a young Nile crocodile embarks on her first season of motherhood. After winning the chance to breed, she faces fierce competition for nesting territory and the challenge of safeguarding her eggs through months of flooding, searing heat and relentless predators. Monitor lizards, mongooses, baboons and rival crocodiles all threaten her nest while she stands guard.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: The Pol clan gets to work on creating Beth’s dream garden. To beat the incoming rainstorm, an exhausted Ben works around the clock to finish building the garden’s pond and waterfall. Noticing her brother is near his breaking point, Beth plans a special surprise to lift his spirits.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: In seemingly endless seas of green and shimmering gold, Africa's grasslands stretch out on an immense scale, home to some of the greatest gatherings of wildlife on earth.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Journey deep into the Australian bush and discover a remarkable world of baby animals growing up beyond the cities and coastline. Meet wombat youngsters learning to explore their underground world and tiny echidna puggles developing the protective spines that will help them survive.

programme.title: Africa Earth's Wild Home T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Africa’s paradise islands are the most isolated homes on the continent. Separated from the mainland millions of years ago, each one has become its own unique world. From the oldest island on the planet, Madagascar, to others that have only just formed, life here has had to rip up the rule book to find unique and ingenious ways to survive.
